proves: NOTHING IS CORRECT IN ROW 0. This image pins a known defect.
defect: row 0 sets align-items:baseline; the three runs align on their BOX BOTTOMS, not their baselines
cause: taffy discards a measured leaf's baseline and then reads the missing value as the leaf's full height. compute_leaf_layout returns first_baselines: Point::NONE unconditionally at taffy-0.13.0/src/compute/leaf.rs:102 and :157, and flexbox falls back to the height at flexbox.rs:1522, :1524, :2037 and :2047. A leaf's baseline is therefore its bottom edge.
not-ours: this renderer measures the baseline and keeps it: layout.rs:173 stores first_baseline in LayoutResult::baselines, and the comment there says why it has to be captured in the measure closure - taffy takes the size and drops the rest. There is no path through TaffyTree by which a measured leaf can report one, because the measure closure returns Size<f32>.
v1-too: not a v2 regression. v1 exposes BASELINE as an align value (canvas.type.ts:447) and calls setMeasureFunc (text.canvas.ts:72) but never setBaselineFunc, and Yoga's default baseline for a childless measured leaf is its height - taffy's fallback exactly. v1 aligns box bottoms for the same reason.
grid-too: grid routes leaves through the same compute_leaf_layout, and taffy additionally carries `TODO: Support baseline alignment in the vertical axis` at grid/mod.rs:342 and :528. Extending this fixture to a grid would pin the same defect twice rather than find a different answer.
measured: H has no descender, so its ink bottom IS the baseline. Row 0 H-bottoms are 5px apart; row 1 (align-items:flex-start, the control) is expected to differ and does.
correct-looks-like: all three H-bottoms in row 0 share one y. Row 1 is unaffected and must not change.
when-taffy-releases: check whether compute_leaf_layout still hard-codes Point::NONE. The type it returns has the field and flexbox reads it; only the leaf path cannot fill it in. LayoutOutput::from_sizes_and_baselines exists, so a tree implementing LayoutPartialTree itself can already supply one - which is the fix if upstream does not move.
status: PINNED DEFECT - re-accept this image when baseline alignment is fixed; a failure here after such a fix is the fix working
